key_findings: Reproduction project resolved. OSF GUID 9wgzk is a file (Transparency Trail) inside node vk2a3, the FLoRA/BERD reproduction 'with author data & code'. Downloaded replication .do files, README, PBR workbook, and 2 of the required datasets (ACT_IllLvlMainWithMalProbs_FINAL_pub, ACT_PharmLogPos_FINAL_pub).

Independently re-computed (Python/statsmodels, clustered OLS by householdid, matching Stata 'clu(househo)' spec) the headline Table 2 results EXACTLY: pooled 'Any ACT subsidy' on took_act = 0.1869 (SE 0.0383) vs paper 0.187 (SE 0.038), N=631.
Table 2 per-subsidy-level coefficients reproduced EXACTLY: act40(92% subsid)=0.2249/0.0528 vs 0.225/0.053; act60(88%)=0.1609/0.0503 vs 0.161/0.050; act100(80%)=0.1780/0.0478 vs 0.178/0.048.
Table 3 column 3 (endline overall ACT targeting from predicted positivity) reproduced EXACTLY: act60=0.1114/0.0526 vs 0.111/0.053; act100=0.0403/0.0519 vs 0.040/0.052.
Central abstract/headline claim (very high subsidy dramatically increases ACT access; pooled act_any=0.187, SE 0.038, 1% sig) is INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED.

Remaining focal claims (Table 3 cols 1-2 DV means/coefficients, Table 4 mechanisms, Table 6 RDT targeting) require the ACT_AllMain_FINAL_pub dataset, which could not be re-obtained this session: OSF storage API returned persistent HTTP 503 on every node/components across ~25 minutes, and the source ICPSR deposit (openicpsr #112911) is access-gated (403). No contradiction found.

Verdict agrees with the human FLoRA assessment ('computationally reproducible'): every headline number that could be independently run matched the published values exactly; the partial grade reflects data-access blockage (missing AllMain dataset), not any numerical discrepancy.
